description: Given a described project, return an OPINIONATED BUILD PLAN: which AETumi catalog assets to start from plus how to ship it — Three.js / WebGL architecture, framework choice (React Three Fiber / Next.js) and performance guidance. Use this when the user describes something to BUILD rather than an item to look up; for a plain ranked list of matching assets use search_3d_web_assets, and for the taxonomy alone use list_3d_web_categories. Read-only, no authentication, no side effects; returns public metadata.

industry.description: Optional target industry, e.g. Automotive, Beauty, Fashion, Real Estate, Fintech.

use_case.description: e.g. "3D product landing page", "agency portfolio hero", "scroll story".

name: recommend_3d_web_stack

suggested.description: Suggested AETumi assets to start from.

title: Recommend a catalog build
